options.label: Canvas world: climb to 50.3%
options.rationale: The talk is an ascent from PaLM's base and the 6.9% prior SOTA up to Minerva's 50.3% on MATH, so one big climbing picture holds the story.

options.label: Warm paper, dots, dark dividers
options.rationale: A paper-like ground with one dot per section suits a sober, scholarly derivation-style talk, and dark dividers separate its four questions.

options.label: Soft mesh, tabs, zoom on table
options.rationale: Section tabs make the four-part argument easy to follow, and a zoom into Table 3 lets the key numbers carry the results.

options.rationale: Quiet fades on a subtly grained ground keep attention on the equations, charts and tables, and blue dividers give a clear rhythm break.
